title: Ring Ring
notes: Formative Swedish pop: folk and glam touches, changing leads and layered title-track sound.

title: Waterloo
scene: Swedish Eurovision pop; early European glam-influenced pop-rock
notes: Eurovision breakthrough with glam guitars, early reggae experiments and both female and male leads.

title: ABBA
notes: Mamma Mia and SOS sharpened their lush hooks amid glam, reggae and instrumental experiments.

title: Arrival
scene: 1970s Swedish international pop; disco and Philadelphia soul crossover
notes: Layered dance-pop elegance offsets emotionally bruised ballads and detailed narrative songs.

title: The Album
scene: Swedish international pop-rock; concept-like theatrical sequences
notes: Ambitious pop-rock, progressive arrangements and three theatrical songs from a miniature stage musical.

title: Voulez-Vous
scene: Swedish disco-era Europop; Stockholm and Miami recording
notes: Disco-heavy productions alternate with reflective Europop ballads and occasional guitar-led rock.

title: Super Trouper
scene: Mature Swedish Europop and early synth-oriented dance-pop
notes: Bittersweet adult pop, heartbreak ballads, synthesizer experiments and a few vibrant dance tracks.
